title: Testing Hooke-like isotropic hyper-/hypo-elastic material models under finite simple shear deformations
summary: We test some Hooke-like isotropic hyper-/hypo-elastic material models under finite simple shear deformations (cf., Thiel et al. Int. J. Non-linear Mech. 112: 57--72, 2019) and show that (1) the components of the Cauchy stress tensor for any Cauchy/Green isotropic elastic material under left finite simple shear (LFSS) deformation are equal to the components of the rotated Cauchy stress tensor for the same material under right finite simple shear (RFSS) deformation; (2) for any Hill's linear isotropic hyperelastic material model based on a symmetrically physical (SP) strain measure, LFSS and…
